Overview Specifications Warranty & Returns
The AMD Ryzen 7 5800X3D 10th Anniversary Edition is the definitive enthusiast desktop processor expertly optimised to deliver next gen performance directly to enduring Socket AM4 gaming rigs. Commemorating a full decade of unmatched AM4 platform legacy, this special edition 105W TDP chip places an all time gaming icon back at the centre of the upgrade conversation, allowing PC builders to sidestep expensive motherboard and DDR5 memory transitions while achieving elite frame rates in modern titles. Driven by 8 cores and 16 threads operating at a 3.4 GHz base clock and up to a 4.5 GHz max boost clock, this 7nm Zen 3 processor features revolutionary AMD 3D V-Cache technology. By vertically stacking a massive 96 MB of L3 cache directly onto the processor die, reducing latency to ensure your 1 percent low frame rates remain beautifully smooth and perfectly stabilised during intense, data-heavy gameplay. For superior thermal management, the CPU is premium bundled with a next generation Carbice Ice Pad, a long lasting solid thermal interface material that simplifies installation by entirely replacing traditional thermal paste. This seamless drop-in solution for AMD 400 and 500 series motherboards, provides a highly durable, future-proof asset for gamers looking to extract absolute peak value out of their existing hardware configuration.



Features

AMD Ryzen™ 7 5800X3D Gaming Processor 10th Anniversary Edition

For ten years, AMD Socket AM4 has been at the center of millions of gaming and PC builds around the world. It delivered smooth gaming and dependable performance, all while making upgrades simple and accessible.

From its first launch to now, AM4 has continued to evolve through multiple processor generations without requiring a new motherboard, giving PC builders a platform they could trust and grow with over time.

AMD Socket AM4 by the Numbers

Over the past decade, AMD Socket AM4 has grown into one of the most widely adopted desktop platforms in the PC community.

  • 10 years of powering PC enthusiasts around the world
  • 5 generations of CPU Architectures supported on a single platform
  • 125+ AMD Ryzen™ processors launched for Socket AM4
  • 500+ Socket AM4 motherboard models, giving builders broad choice and flexibility

These milestones reflect AMD’s long standing commitment to platform longevity and upgrade flexibility.

Milestone Worth Revisiting: The AMD Ryzen™ 7 5800X3D Processor Is Back

The AMD Ryzen™ 7 5800X3D Processor stands as the ultimate gaming processor for DDR4 platforms, showcasing how far the AM4 platform could be taken for gamers delivering an average of 10% more fps than the 14900K when using DDR4-3600 MHz memory, and on a platform that has supported upgrades over 6 years longer.

Built on the proven Ryzen™ 5000 Series with AMD “Zen 3” architecture cores and 7nm process technology, it introduced 1st Gen AMD 3D V Cache™ technology to desktop gaming and raised expectations for performance on an established platform.

As the first gaming processor to feature 3D stacked cache, the Ryzen 7 5800X3D delivers a massive 96MB of L3 cache to help boost gaming performance and responsiveness across a wide range of titles. The result is smoother gameplay, higher framerates, and lower latency, making the Ryzen 7 5800X3D one of the most celebrated gaming processors ever released on Socket AM4.

The Ultimate AM4 Gaming Upgrade Starts with 5800X3D

One of the defining strengths of AMD Socket AM4 has always been its ability to deliver meaningful performance upgrades without requiring a full system rebuild.

Designed to drop directly into existing AM4 systems with supported motherboards, the Ryzen 7 5800X3D processor allows users to unlock a new level of gaming performance while keeping their motherboard, memory, storage, and cooling intact. It is a straightforward path to extending the life of an already trusted system.

For those gamers who are looking for the maximum uplift through an in-socket upgrade on their existing motherboard, the Ryzen™ 7 5800X3D processor can deliver over 2X higher gaming performance FPS across a range of games compared to Ryzen™ 7 2700X, and over 40 percent versus Ryzen™ 7 3700X when paired with a high-end graphics card.

Added Value for Long‑Term Performance with Carbice® Ice Pad™

Every Ryzen™ 7 5800X3D processor comes bundled with a Carbice® IcePad™ thermal pad, adding extra value for gamers upgrading within the AM4 platform

While traditional thermal paste can perform well initially, many paste suppliers recommend repasting over time to help maintain optimal performance. Carbice® IcePad™ is designed to settle quickly and deliver more consistent thermal performance across extended use, without the mess or upkeep of reapplication.
